source_branches.when: asset throttle, authentication, timezone activation, permission decorator, and protocol order
source_branches.observable: A 5/minute DRF AssetRateThrottle uses Redis key :1:throttle_asset_<asset UUID>, shared across users and workspace slugs for the same asset UUID. The fifth request is allowed; the sixth returns 429 with error_code 5900, error_message RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, and Retry-After. IsAuthenticated denial occurs before throttling and does not consume a slot. For authenticated requests, throttle checks happen in BaseAPIView.initial before TimezoneMixin activates the user timezone and before the POST allow_permission decorator runs; therefore an exhausted bucket returns 429 even for an invalid timezone, while a workspace-member denial consumes a slot. Ordinary OPTIONS and unsupported PUT pass through throttling; CORS preflight exits before the view and does not consume a slot. Expired history is pruned before counting.
